vendor: CoreLogic, Inc. (operating as Cotality since March 2025)
product_family: Real estate property data, analytics, AI, and SaaS for real estate professionals, insurance, mortgage, and government. Key products: Matrix (MLS platform), OneHome (buyer portal), DASH/MICA/SettleAssist (insurance/restoration), Trestle (data marketplace), CoreAI (AI analytics), RiskMeter, and Hazard HQ Command Central.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: CoreLogic/Next Gear Solutions earned SOC 2 Type II certification on November 17, 2022, for its three SaaS-based offerings: DASH, MICA, and SettleAssist. The audit was conducted by Grant Thornton (AICPA-authorized), with annual renewal required. This certification covers only the Next Gear Solutions subsidiary products; there is no public evidence of SOC 2 coverage for the core Cotality platform (Matrix, Trestle, CoreAI, and others).

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on any Cotality or CoreLogic domain, trust center, or third-party certification registry.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: CoreLogic, Inc. and our U.S. entities and subsidiaries Symbility Solutions Corp., Next Gear Solutions, LLC, and CoreLogic Solutions, LLC have certified our participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the UK extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, and the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework with the U.S. Department of Commerce.

certifications.name: UK Extension to EU-US DPF
certifications.proof_quote: CoreLogic, Inc. and our U.S. entities and subsidiaries ... have certified our participation in ... the UK extension to the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.

certifications.name: Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: CoreLogic, Inc. and our U.S. entities and subsidiaries ... have certified our participation in ... the Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Framework with the U.S. Department of Commerce.

certifications.name: GDPR (formal certification)
certifications.proof_quote: No formal GDPR certification exists as a recognized standard. CoreLogic handles EU-EEA personal data transfers via the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (certified). The DPF policy references GDPR compliance obligations. No adequacy decision or BCR documented publicly.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance documentation, Business Associate Agreement template, or HIPAA attestation found on the Cotality or CoreLogic domains. Law Insider references suggest CoreLogic contracts reference HIPAA Rules in client agreements, but no formal compliance page or attestation was found.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification or compliance documentation found on the Cotality or CoreLogic domains.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found. Cotality serves government clients but no FedRAMP listing or documentation was identified.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Cotality operates CoreAI for property analytics but no AI governance certification was identified.

privacy.ai_training_note: CoreAI intelligence uses Cotality's own proprietary property databases (98%+ property coverage, 1M+ data points refreshed monthly, 30 years of historical data). No explicit policy language addresses training AI models on customer-submitted data. The terms of use grant Cotality a broad, royalty-free, perpetual license to use submitted content but do not specifically address AI model training.
privacy.data_region: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand (per privacy policy: 'generally stored and processed in the United States or Canada' but 'may be stored and processed in and transferred between any of the countries in which we operate')

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS with SHA-256; no insecure SSL/TLS versions available (per UpGuard external scan)

security.name: Email security
security.value: DMARC and SPF configured with strict filtering (per UpGuard external scan)

security.name: Cookie security
security.value: Secure cookies and HttpOnly cookies implemented; server headers do not expose version information

security.name: Known gaps (external scan)
security.value: HSTS not enforced; DNSSEC disabled; HTTP port exposed to internet

security.name: Past security incident
security.value: February 2019: RiskMeter database breach - client credentials and property data accessed by unauthorized party and moved to external server. Lawsuit filed; no evidence of public data leak reported.

flags: The company rebranded from CoreLogic to Cotality in March 2025. The legal entity remains CoreLogic, Inc., as confirmed by the copyright footer on cotality.com.

SOC 2 Type II certification covers only the Next Gear Solutions subsidiary products (DASH, MICA, SettleAssist). There is no public evidence that the core Cotality platform products (Matrix, Trestle, CoreAI, RiskMeter) are SOC 2 certified.
In February 2019, a breach of the RiskMeter database exposed client credentials and property data. No public data leak was confirmed, but a lawsuit was filed.
No Data Processing Agreement template is publicly available; business customers must request DPA terms directly.
Terms of use grant a broad, royalty-free license to submitted content, with no explicit opt-out or prohibition on AI model training from customer interactions.
No public HIPAA or PCI DSS compliance documentation was found, despite the company serving insurance and financial services sectors that typically require these.
